preconditions.description: The number of olympiads before the rule was introduced is at least 1 and at most 500000.
The number of cities in Berland wishing to host the olympiad is at least 1 and at most 500000.
The number of years Misha's mother is interested in is at least 1 and at most 500000.
The host city of each olympiad is numbered between 1 and m.
The year number Misha's mother is interested in is at least n + 1 and at most 10^18.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= m for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a city number between 1 and m.
